nom: Origins Checks and Balances Polishing Face Scrub

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, combination skin reports the scrub left her face clean and breakout-free, and recommends it to others with oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one whose dryness she attributes to menopause, describe the scrub as gentle and effective, leaving skin smoother, softer and less flaky.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mostly positive results, including reduced breakouts and a more even tone, though one found it left a heavier residue than her usual cleanser.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some on photosensitizing medication, report no irritation from the scrub, but a minority describe reactions ranging from mild inflammation to hives, rash and red patches severe enough to stop use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 70s report the scrub still suits their long-standing exfoliation needs, though one 71-year-old notes an ingredient mildly inflames and tingles her skin compared to the discontinued product she used for decades.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, describe the scrub leaving skin soft, smooth and hydrated rather than dry; a minority report the opposite, with skin turning extremely dry, scaly or flaky enough to stop use, and one reviewer cautions that any exfoliator can be drying without a follow-up moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation; a notable minority describe visible redness, blotchiness or rash, in a couple of cases spreading to the neck or chest.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers credit continued use with fewer blackheads, whiteheads and breakouts; dissent comes from at least one reviewer in her 30s who reports the scrub caused more breakouts and pain than the discontinued product it replaced.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the creamy formula as not stripping her face of its natural moisture, unlike other scrubs that had irritated her skin.

aspects.libelle: Seen as an inferior substitute for discontinued Modern Friction
Grit feels sharp or abrasive to many users
Gentle enough for frequent, non-irritating use
Small amount needed, lasts a long time
Small tube size relative to the price

extraits.texte: I love the frothy face wash so I thought I'd give this product a try. First, the grains are extremely fine and I agree with other reviewers that it doesn't feel good on my skin. Very gritty and hard to wash off. But the main issue was my reaction to the product. In the 2 days after use, my skin became extremely dry and scaly and I developed hives and red patches all over my face and neck. Resolved in a few days with my normal cleanser and moisturizer but if you have sensitive skin, proceed with extreme caution here. I have never reacted to a product like this and it's clearly uncommon given the positive reviews, but be careful! I had to toss the product after use because of my reaction.

extraits.titre: Terrible. Not a suitable replacement for Never a Dull Moment
extraits.texte: I've been using Origins products for well over 25 years. I'm a huge fan of Checks & Balancing foaming cleanser. I use nothing else to wash my face. I tried this when Never a Dull Moment was discontinued. Horrible! The frangance is awful & it made my face red & blotchy. I used it once & threw the entire bottle in the trash. Complete waste of money. Now I see they've also discontinued Modern Friction. That was my back up for Never a Dull Moment. Now I can't get either one. Stop discontinuing the products that actually work Origins! I now have no options for an exholiator from you. Very disaapointed.

I don't get the negative reviews at all- I love this stuff and am on my third tube now. It smells great, a little goes a long way. I have very dry skin due to menopause and one use of this makes my skin glow and feel baby smooth. I can't not use this, this is my holy grail of exfoliators.

I have fair, sensitive skin, which is further sensitized to light due to daily medication I take. I need to be extra careful with the skin care products I use. I love to use a facial scrub 1-2x/week but had trouble finding one for a couple of years since the ones tried all irritated my skin. I was hopeful this one would be different, & it was! It is still a facial scrub, but it is light & non-irritating with a creamy undertone to help my face not feel stripped of its natural moisture. The fragrance of the natural ingredients are uplifting & fresh too. For me, a little bit goes a long way when I use it. "Checks & Balances" is truly a versatile line for any skin types.

I have combination skin and have always struggled to find a scrub wash that could clear up my acne, my skin in on more the oiler side and tend to have sensitive skin. now i had a chance to try the Origins Checks & Balances Scrub face wash and is amazing!! my skin is clean and fresh after using it. is very creamy and foams up very nice so a little goes a long way, It does not dry out my face, really makes my face feel clean, soft and glowing!!! I have not broken out since I started using this, Its in perfect balance and rinses clean. It is easy to use, after cleansing massage into damp skin using a circular motion, rinse and pat dry. I use this product of 3 a 4 times per week. I love it leave my face like baby-soft skin. I highly recommend it for those like me who have oily skin, you will notice the difference.

extraits.titre: BRING BACK MODERN FRICTION! this product SUCKS!
extraits.texte: I have been using checks and balances frothy face wash and modern friction since I was a teenager, and it was the ONLY combo that kept acne and breakouts down. Now that modern friction is no longer available, I bought this hoping it would be a suitable replacement.... NOPE! not only is it a painful experience, but its been making me breakout more than I ever have, and I'm in my 30s! I have tried many different combinations to try to combat the pain and/or the oily feeling after using, and nothing helps with the breakouts. Seriously missing modern friction. I'm so disappointed in you guys for getting rid of a product that worked for one that just sucks.

extraits.titre: Everything I want in a scrub!
extraits.texte: I think this is my favorite product here! I'm 70 and my skin has changed but I have always needed exfoliation. After 50 years of using scrub cleansers, this is my favorite. It's lightweight and uses irregular minerals to scrub, not the "beads" in other scrubs that don't seem to get to the blackheads I still have at this age. And it has the added benefit of the same feel as the frothy checks and balances face wash....light and minty!
